name: Louis XV
source:
"Surrounded by all these young people, I almost feel like I've become younger myself, haha."

Born in France.
Hobby: Hunting, Admiring Art
Likes: Beautiful Women and Delicious Food
Dislikes: Troublesome Things

The King of France.
A sociable man who gives off a friendly atmosphere, he loves to eat and laugh.
No matter how old he gets he's never lost his intrest in women.
He often listens to the crown princess's worries about her relationship with the crown prince.
